title: Recruiter Workspace
summary: Your entire hiring pipeline, team feedback and approval workflows in one view.
headline: Your entire hiring process, *in one place*
lede: Stop switching between spreadsheets, inboxes and chat threads. The TalentPool365 Recruiter Workspace brings your pipeline, team and decisions together, so everyone knows where every candidate stands and what needs to happen next.
sectionIntro: Stop switching between spreadsheets, inboxes and chat threads. The TalentPool365 Recruiter Workspace brings your pipeline, team and decisions together, so everyone knows where every candidate stands and what needs to happen next.

capabilities.title: Candidate Pipeline
capabilities.tagline: See every candidate, at every stage, at a glance.
capabilities.body: Track candidates from first contact to offer on a visual board. Move people between stages with a simple drag and drop, and never lose track of who is waiting on whom.
points: Customizable stages to match your hiring process
Drag-and-drop board and list views
Filter by role, stage, recruiter or source
Automatic updates when candidates complete assessments or interviews

capabilities.title: Hiring Dashboard
capabilities.tagline: Know how your hiring is performing, in real time.
capabilities.body: Get a live view of open roles, applicants, interviews and offers. Spot bottlenecks early and see what’s working, without building reports by hand.
points: Open roles, pipeline and progress summaries
Time-to-hire and stage-wise conversion tracking
Source-wise insights to show where your best candidates come from
Shareable reports for leadership and hiring managers

capabilities.title: Team Collaboration
capabilities.tagline: Recruiters and hiring managers, working as one team.
capabilities.body: Bring everyone involved in a hire into the same workspace. Share candidates, assign tasks and keep conversations attached to the people they’re about.
points: Invite recruiters, hiring managers and interviewers
Role-based access to control who sees what
@mentions and task assignments on candidate profiles
Shared candidate profiles instead of forwarded resumes

capabilities.title: Notes & Feedback
capabilities.tagline: Capture every opinion, and keep it organized.
capabilities.body: Collect structured feedback after every interview and keep notes right on the candidate profile. Your team’s insights stay in one place and don’t get lost in email.
points: Private and shared notes on each candidate
Structured scorecards for consistent feedback
Interviewer ratings and recommendations
Complete history of comments and decisions for every candidate

capabilities.title: Approval Workflow
capabilities.tagline: Get decisions made faster, with a clear paper trail.
capabilities.body: Set up approval steps for job requisitions, shortlists and offers. The right people are notified, so decisions don’t stall in someone’s inbox.
points: Custom approval chains for roles, budgets and offers
Automatic notifications and reminders to approvers
One-click approve or reject with comments
Audit trail showing who approved what and when

outcomes.label: pipeline visibility across all open requisitions
faster feedback turnaround from hiring managers
lost candidate records or rogue spreadsheets

closingCta.headline: Give your hiring team one workspace to get it done.
closingCta.body: See how TalentPool365 keeps your pipeline moving and everyone aligned.
